description: Create History page to display all past conversations with filtering (All/Open/Resolved), pagination, and delete functionality. Includes API endpoint to delete conversations and their messages. This gives users a clean way to manage conversation history.
steps: 1. Create apps/dashboard/src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/history/page.tsx with a client component that fetches conversations from /workspaces/:workspaceId/conversations?limit=20&status=<filter>
2. Implement filter tabs: All, Open, Resolved - clicking a tab updates the status query param and refetches

3. Display conversations in a table with columns: Visitor (avatar with gradient background using getAvatarColor pattern + display name), Website (website.name or domain), Full URL (visitor.currentPageUrl, fallback to website domain), Date (lastMessageAt formatted), Messages (show message count if available, or fetch), Status (badge with color: green for resolved, blue for open, yellow for pending), Actions (Delete button icon)

4. Delete button opens a confirmation dialog (use native confirm() for simplicity), then optimistically removes from UI and calls DELETE /workspaces/:workspaceId/conversations/:conversationId endpoint
5. Add pagination controls at bottom: Previous/Next buttons, show 20 per page, use cursor-based pagination with lastMessageAt
6. Add empty state: 'No conversation history yet' when the list is empty

7. Add DELETE /workspaces/:workspaceId/conversations/:conversationId route handler in apps/api/src/routes/workspaces.ts: require authentication + CSRF token, use requireWorkspaceMember and requireConversation for authorization, delete all messages with Message.deleteMany({ conversationId }), delete conversation with Conversation.findByIdAndDelete(conversationId), return 204 No Content
8. Handle delete errors gracefully - if API call fails, re-add the conversation to UI and show error message
acceptance_criteria: Page shows list of conversations with all required columns
Filter tabs work - All shows all conversations, Open shows status=open, Resolved shows status=resolved
Delete button prompts for confirmation before deleting
DELETE API endpoint successfully removes conversation and all its messages from MongoDB
Pagination works - shows 20 items per page with Previous/Next navigation
Empty state displays when no conversations exist
Full URL from visitor.currentPageUrl displays correctly in the table
verification: Run npm run dev from workspace root
Verify conversation list displays with all columns
Click filter tabs (All, Open, Resolved) and verify filtering works
Click Delete on a conversation, confirm the dialog, verify it disappears from UI
Check MongoDB directly to confirm conversation and messages are deleted
Test pagination if more than 20 conversations exist
Test empty state by deleting all conversations
findings: Successfully implemented the History page at /dashboard/history with full conversation listing, filtering (All/Open/Resolved), and delete functionality. Created a responsive table view showing visitor information with avatar, website name, full URL from visitor.currentPageUrl, formatted date, status badge, and delete button. Implemented DELETE API endpoint at /workspaces/:workspaceId/conversations/:conversationId that removes both the conversation and all associated messages from MongoDB using requireConversation for authorization. Added optimistic UI updates with error recovery, pagination (20 items per page with cursor-based 'Load More'), and empty state messaging. Build completed successfully with no TypeScript errors.
